VOICE: Respond in clear, plain, professional English — concise and precise, no affectation.
TAGLINE: A portable, theme-able harness you implant into any repository to grow a disciplined AI agent.
LOADED_SIGIL: ✅ Harness loaded — rules in force, agents and skills ready.
EPI_ONTOLOGY: What this agent is for, and how it decides — read before any rule below.
EPI_LAWS: The rules below hold in every task, in every repository.
EPI_DOCTRINES: Optional rule sets. Only the ones this repository enabled appear here.
EPI_AGENTS: Send the right specialist instead of doing everything in one context.
EPI_SKILLS: Run the written procedure before improvising.
EPI_MEMORY: What is worth keeping must outlive the session in writing.
EPI_VAULT: Read where you were installed — it holds more than the harness.
EPI_CONTEXT: Point the agent at the project's own docs, wherever they live.
EPI_SCRIPTS: Optional automation for teams that want hard enforcement.
BENEDICTION: Work with discipline, keep the rules, and ship clean.
DESC_REVIEWER: Reviews a change for correctness and quality before merge.
DESC_DEVELOPER: Implements the scoped change in an isolated worktree.
DESC_ARCHITECT: Designs the plan before any code is written.
DESC_DOCS: Writes user-facing docs once the code lands.
DESC_SECURITY: Audits changes that touch the security surface.
DESC_PERFORMANCE: Measures time and memory and names the bottleneck.
DESC_EXPLORER: Searches widely in a throwaway context; returns findings.
DESC_RESEARCHER: Searches the web; checks each claim against two sources.
DESC_MEMORY_CURATOR: Merges, files and archives facts in the memory store.
DESC_ADVOCATE: Presses the upside and the cost of not acting.
DESC_SKEPTIC: Attacks failure modes, risks and hidden assumptions.
DESC_PRAGMATIST: Weighs the cost and effort against the payoff.
DESC_VISIONARY: Argues the 10x upside and what it would take.
DESC_USER_ADVOCATE: Speaks for the user's experience and friction.
DESC_FRAMER: Asks whether the motion treats a cause or a symptom.
DESC_EMPIRICIST: Demands data, tests or precedent behind each claim.
DESC_OPERATOR: Weighs rollback, on-call and upkeep burden.
DESC_HISTORIAN: Recalls what was tried before and how it went.
DESC_SPRING_BOOT_ENGINEER: Implements a Spring Boot feature or service end to end.
DESC_SPRING_REVIEWER: Reviews a Spring Boot change with framework knowledge.
DESC_SPRING_SECURITY: Reviews a Spring Security change: filters, OAuth2, CSRF.
DESC_KUBERNETES_SPECIALIST: Writes or reviews Kubernetes manifests for Spring Boot.
DESC_DOCKER_EXPERT: Writes or reviews a Spring Boot Dockerfile; not Compose ops.
DESC_DEVOPS_ENGINEER: Improves the CI build and delivery of a Spring Boot service.
DESC_REACT_ENGINEER: Implements a React feature or makes a red build green.
DESC_REACT_REVIEWER: Reviews a React change with framework knowledge.
DESC_PLAN: Write a plan to a file before a non-trivial task; track it.
DESC_DEPENDENCIES: Audit dependencies, then upgrade them one change at a time.
DESC_GIT_HISTORY: Read git history (bisect, blame) or rewrite it safely.
DESC_DOCUMENT_PROJECT: Write the PRD, architecture and AGENTS.md from the code.
DESC_COMMIT: Stage the right paths and write a focused commit.
DESC_CODE_REVIEW: Review a diff or PR for correctness first, quality second.
DESC_BRAINSTORM: Turn a raw idea into an approved design before code.
DESC_CODEBASE_DESIGN: Design deep modules, seams, a glossary and ADRs.
DESC_WAYFINDER: Chart too-big work as a map of decision tickets.
DESC_PROTOTYPE: Answer a design question with throwaway code.
DESC_ROAST_ME: Critique the user's own ask, plan or idea, brutally.
DESC_FRESH_EYES: Have a context-free agent judge the work against the ask.
ROAST_PERSONA: a blunt, no-nonsense senior reviewer who has watched this exact thing fail before
DESC_COUNCIL: Debate a decision from several viewpoints, then rule.
DESC_DEBUG: Find and fix a bug by evidence: reproduce, isolate, verify.
DESC_REFACTOR: Improve structure without changing behaviour, tests green.
DESC_PONYTAIL: Force the laziest solution that works. lite/full/ultra.
DESC_PARALLEL_AGENTS: Fan independent subtasks out to concurrent subagents.
DESC_PIPELINE: Spawn a crew in a worktree; merge on green tests and lint.
DESC_LOOP: Work a requirement in small, scored loop iterations.
DESC_FACTORY: Carry one work item through a factory to a PR with green CI.
DESC_BRICK_FORGE: Author or adapt a loop brick and check it.
DESC_FACTORY_FORGE: Compose bricks and loops into a checked factory.
DESC_DEVELOP: Drive a change through tests: smallest change, suite green.
DESC_TEACH: Teach the user toward a result, or test what they know.
DESC_ADHD: Shape replies for a reader with ADHD: next action first.
DESC_LEARN_MODE: Learn while building: the user designs, the agent explains.
DESC_OWNERSHIP: Keep the developer the owner of the code, part by part.
DESC_SECURITY_AUDIT: Review a change as an attacker would; ship, fix or block.
DESC_SKILL_FORGE: Author, sharpen, merge or retire a skill.
DESC_WORKTREE: Isolate a task in its own git worktree from a clean base.
DESC_HANDOFF: Snapshot task state so a fresh context can resume.
DESC_SHIP: Open a pull request, or merge a verified branch.
DESC_RELEASE: Cut a release: version, changelog and tag in sync.
DESC_INGEST: Convert a PDF, Office or web document to markdown.
DESC_RESEARCH: Answer from the web, each claim checked against sources.
DESC_RULE: Sort a standing rule from a memory, then record it.
DESC_PROFILE: Interview the user and draft or refresh PROFILE.md.
DESC_GENESEED: Operate the Geneseed harness; make an OpenCode theme.
DESC_REVIEW_RESPONSE: Verify each review point, then apply or decline it.

INTRO_DOC: This file is the entry point an AI coding agent reads when working in this repository.
INTRO_AGENTS: Delegate focused work to a specialist rather than doing everything in one context. Each specialist has a single clear purpose and a defined output contract.
INTRO_SKILLS: A Skill is a written procedure for a recurring task. Run the matching Skill before improvising.
INTRO_WORKSPACE: The directory this harness is installed into is its **Workspace**, and it is shared.
INTRO_SCRIPTS: Everything above works on agent self-discipline alone.
EPI_NOTEBOOK: A space of your own — arrange it however serves the work.
INTRO_NOTEBOOK: This is a working space that is **yours alone** — unlike the shared Workspace around you, you own every file here, to create, organise, move, and keep however serves the work. The rules of this space are yours to write — and rewrite — as your practice evolves; code, data, and tools belong here as much as notes.
EPI_WIKI: The user's own knowledge base — consult it first, grow it as you learn.
INTRO_WIKI: The user may keep a personal knowledge base on this machine — an Obsidian vault, or any folder of interlinked markdown notes — that outlives any single repository.
DESC_WIKI: Consult and grow the user's personal knowledge base.
DESC_MCP: Build or harden a Model Context Protocol server.
DESC_BRUNO: Build, reorganise or test a Bruno API collection.
DESC_PROSE: Write prose for a human that doesn't read like a model.
DESC_FRONTEND_DESIGN: Design a UI with a point of view, not template defaults.
DESC_DECK: Build slides as one self-contained offline HTML file.
DESC_WORKFLOW: Run a saved script that orchestrates subagents.
DESC_SPRING_BOOT: Build or change a Spring Boot service and its config.
DESC_SPRING_DATA_JPA: Spring Data JPA and Hibernate: entities, queries, N+1.
DESC_SPRING_TESTING: Write or fix Spring Boot tests: slices, Testcontainers.
DESC_REACT: Build or change React components in a Vite or webpack app.
DESC_REACT_TESTING: Write or fix React tests: Jest, Testing Library, MSW.
DESC_JENKINS_PIPELINE: Write or fix a declarative Jenkinsfile or shared library.
DESC_GITLAB_CI: Write or fix .gitlab-ci.yml: rules, needs, includes, cache.
DESC_COMPOSE_OPS: Write, review or run a Compose stack; not image builds.
DESC_HERDR: Drive Herdr panes and agents from inside it; only when the user names Herdr.
DESC_OPENCODE_CLI: Drive OpenCode V2 from its CLI: run, sessions, server, MCP, plugins.
